cards.card_text: Calamity came down from the LORD, even to the gate of Jerusalem, and Lachish is called the beginning of sin to the Daughter of Zion.
cards.verse_text: Do not tell it in Gath; do not weep at all. Roll in the dust in Beth-leaphrah. Depart in shameful nakedness, O dwellers of Shaphir. The dwellers of Zaanan will not come out. Beth-ezel is in mourning; its support is taken from you. For the dwellers of Maroth pined for good, but calamity came down from the LORD, even to the gate of Jerusalem.
